quarterly_data.quarter: Dingtong Technology results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (06-02-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Liquid cooling and capacity (results briefing): chairman Wang Chenghai said 2 liquid-cooling lines are running and the company plans 5 lines in total this year, with the expansion expected to complete in H2 2026; liquid-cooling capacity utilization is not yet saturated. Its 224G liquid-cooled heat sink has passed customer certification and is in line debugging and ramp. The new plant near the Dongguan headquarters is expected in use in H2 2026, and the company is meanwhile leasing space to add lines. Board secretary Wang Xiaolan said the Malaysian base runs steadily and profitably with utilization rising as overseas core customers' orders are delivered.

quarterly_data.quarter: Dingtong Technology results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (06-02-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customers and pricing (results briefing): chairman Wang Chenghai said the company's direct customers are mainly Amphenol, Molex, TE Connectivity and AVIC Jonhon; it has no direct business with domestic server and telecom makers Inspur, Huawei and ZTE, supplying them indirectly through Amphenol, Molex and TE Connectivity. CFO Chen Gongping said copper, plastics and hardware are the main cost items, managed with long-term price locks and centralised purchasing, and that market-based price-linkage mechanisms with Amphenol and Molex allow periodic price adjustment for raw-material swings. The chairman said the company has no plans for optical-communication products and that NPO / CPO do not threaten its cage business.
